rulesClauses: Discard up to three ally cards from your hand and/or memory, then draw that many cards.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. StonescaleBandDiscard's loop re-queue AddDecision omitted dontSkipOnPass, so declining a further discard (MZMAYCHOOSE answered PASS) made ExecuteStaticMethods() skip the handler and its PASS branch (Draw $count) never ran: an ally was discarded but no card was drawn (live repro on HEAD: hand stayed at 6). Fix: dontSkipOnPass:1 on the re-queue.
